title: Power BI and Executive Insights Lead
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 Team \- EY Strategy Execution \& Operations (SE\&O)
   

  

 Stakeholder(s) \- C\&I Executive Insights Command Centre
   

  

 Role Title(s) \- Power BI \& Executive Insights Lead
   

  

 SE\&O Competency Pillar \- SEO Region Support USLI
   

  

**The Role**
 The Strategy \& Value Insights Lead is responsible for enabling business leaders understand markets performance along with key drivers with actionable and impactful insights. This professional needs to be able to examine data, derive patterns, infer insights in the lens of business context and generate easy to understand business narratives.
   

  

 The Power BI \& Executive Insights Lead will design, develop and maintain executive reporting solutions, dashboards and analytical products for USLI leadership. The role combines Power BI development, data modelling and visualization with business analytics to transform Markets and performance data into clear, actionable executive insights. The successful candidate will understand the EY reporting environment and collaborate with business stakeholders, data owners and Global Analytics teams to deliver trusted, scalable and decision\-ready reporting.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Dashboard Development \& Reporting**
* Design, develop, test and maintain Power BI dashboards, executive scorecards and recurring leadership reports.
* Create scalable reporting frameworks, reusable data models and standardized visualization components.
* Automate reporting workflows to reduce manual effort and improve timeliness, consistency and usability.
* Apply effective information design and data storytelling principles to produce executive\-ready outputs.
* Document data sources, logic, calculations, refresh processes and user guidance.
* Build efficiencies, automation and standardization of data workflows
* Develop and maintain collaboration tools and portals to facilitate seamless and efficient operations.
* Provide baselines, targets and measure progress to goals


**Executive Insights \& Analytics**
* Analyze Markets, revenue, sales, pipeline, pursuits, growth and operational performance data.
* Identify trends, risks, opportunities, exceptions and key performance drivers.
* Translate complex analysis into concise business narratives, visuals and recommendations for leadership decision\-making.
* Support performance diagnostics, planning, forecasting and leadership review cycles.
* Combine business context with data findings to develop actionable, easy\-to\-consume insights.


**Data Management, Governance \& Innovation**
* Partner with data owners and stakeholders to validate data quality, definitions and reporting logic.
* Support KPI standardization, reporting governance, access controls and consistency across executive deliverables.
* Investigate data issues, perform root\-cause analysis and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
* Leverage EY Global Analytics tools, Power Platform capabilities and appropriate AI\-enabled tools to enhance reporting and insight generation.
* Identify opportunities for self\-service analytics, workflow efficiency and continuous improvement.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Advanced Power BI development skills, including DAX, Power Query, data modelling, visualization and dashboard performance optimization.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to connect data to business context.
* Good knowledge of EY reporting, Markets data and Global Analytics tools.
* Understanding of revenue, sales, pipeline, pursuits, growth and performance metrics.
* Executive data storytelling, presentation and business writing capability.
* Strong stakeholder management, requirements gathering and communication skills.
* High attention to detail and a strong focus on data accuracy and quality.
* Advanced Excel skills; exposure to MS365 Power Platform, Co\-pilot or related analytics technologies is beneficial.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 12\+ years of work experience
* Exposure to Big 4 or leading consulting firms is a plus
* Relevant experience in business intelligence, analytics, executive reporting, data visualization or dashboard development at a level appropriate for a Supervising Associate role.
* Demonstrated experience delivering Power BI solutions and leadership\-facing reporting products.
* Experience with EY reporting, Markets data, Global Analytics or a comparable professional services reporting environment is preferred.
* Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in analytics, information systems, business, statistics, engineering or a related discipline.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: GDS Cyber - DPP - Staff - AI Data Protection Engineering
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Data Protection Field Engineer**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Field Engineer to help deploy, integrate, test, and troubleshoot AI\-enabled data protection solutions for global clients. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on helping clients secure sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, endpoint, collaboration, and AI\-enabled environments by combining strong data protection fundamentals with practical AI engineering skills. The role is designed for professionals with early\-career to mid\-career experience who enjoy solving real client problems in delivery settings and building technical depth in modern data protection. The internal role design emphasizes deployment, model/platform integration, testing, and troubleshooting, while comparable market roles emphasize customer\-facing engineering, rapid iteration, and production\-grade solution delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Configure, deploy, and support AI\-enabled data protection capabilities across client environments, including data discovery, classification, DLP\-aligned controls, PKI/KMS integrations, and information rights management patterns.
* Integrate data protection platforms with AI models, copilots, and enterprise workflows to help clients protect sensitive information used in prompts, retrieval sources, generated outputs, and broader AI use cases.
* Execute implementation, validation, testing, and troubleshooting tasks for client deployments, including configuration tuning, issue identification, root\-cause analysis, and stabilization support.
* Support workshops, technical assessments, pilots, and proof\-of\-value activities by translating business and security requirements into practical engineering tasks. External field/FDE patterns emphasize embedding closely with customers and iterating quickly based on feedback, which should be reflected in this role.
* Contribute to reusable playbooks, deployment guides, code snippets, engineering templates, and configuration standards that improve repeatability across engagements. Reusable accelerators and reference implementations are a common requirement in comparable AI engineering roles.
* Work with cross\-functional teams spanning cybersecurity, privacy, AI engineering, cloud, and client stakeholders to deliver secure and workable outcomes.


**Required Qualifications**
* Up to 5 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: data protection, DLP, information protection, data discovery/classification, security engineering, cloud security, or related cybersecurity engineering domains.
* Working knowledge of data protection fundamentals, including data discovery and classification, DLP concepts, PKI \& KMS, and information rights management.
* Practical familiarity with AI/ML concepts relevant to data protection, including machine learning, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring.
* Experience with at least some of the following tools/platforms: Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, VS Code with AI extensions, Claude Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise, Cyera, Varonis, Sentra, CrowdStrike Falcon DSPM, Wiz DSPM, Microsoft Purview, Python, TensorFlow.
* Strong troubleshooting mindset, structured communication, and comfort working in client\-facing delivery environments. Field engineering patterns from Microsoft and AI FDE patterns from the market both strongly emphasize technical depth plus customer communication.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to Microsoft Purview, DSPM, CASB, sensitivity labeling, data lineage, encryption, or privacy engineering.
* Experience writing small scripts, automations, or integrations in Python.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native deployments on Azure, AWS, or GCP, and basic understanding of APIs and enterprise integrations. Comparable AI delivery roles frequently require these capabilities.


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

* Typical work environment
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model

description:

O9 is the system of record for demand forecasting, supply planning, and allocation decisions across our brands, regions, and channels. This role owns the day\-to\-day health of the platform — triaging and resolving incidents, maintaining data integrity between O9 and upstream/downstream systems such as Oracle EBS, and partnering with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and Merchandising teams to keep the platform reliable, accurate, and easy to use across a global user base (US, UK, EMEA, and APAC).

* Diagnose and fix planning logic issues — unmet demand, incorrect season codes, planned orders not grouping correctly, buy dates shifting unexpectedly, and similar planning\-engine anomalies.
* Manage user access and provisioning (new hires, role changes, regional access, ownership transfers) and drive toward self\-service or bulk\-provisioning workflows to reduce manual ticket volume.
* Own incident and backlog hygiene: track SLAs, prioritize aging tickets, and ensure nothing sits unresolved for months without visibility to stakeholders.

* Build and maintain runbooks, root\-cause documentation, and knowledge base articles so common issues can be resolved consistently — not just by institutional memory.
* Support configuration changes, workflow updates, and enhancements within O9 as the retailer's planning processes evolve (new brands, new seasons, new regions).
* Participate in O9 platform upgrades, testing cycles, and post\-implementation review (PIR) processes for major changes.
* Escalate to and collaborate with O9 Solutions' vendor support team on platform\-level defects that require vendor engineering involvement.
* Skillset
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience supporting or implementing O9\.
* Solid understanding of retail supply chain planning concepts: demand forecasting, supply/buy planning, allocation, assortment, and season/style\-color management.
* Experience integrating planning systems with ERP platforms, ideally Oracle EBS, including familiarity with common data reconciliation issues between planning and execution systems.
* Strong troubleshooting skills — comfortable reading data flows end\-to\-end to isolate whether an issue originates in source data, integration, or planning logic.
* Experience with incident management tools (ServiceNow or similar) and a track record of managing ticket queues, SLAs, and prioritization in a production support environment.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data investigation and validation.
* Excellent written communication skills — you'll be documenting root causes and explaining technical issues to non\-technical business stakeholders across time zones.
